mentions.name: Black Hole
mentions.description: A website where visitors can throw their thoughts into a virtual black hole, which has so far swallowed 1,205 thoughts. Writing down upsetting thoughts and dropping them into the black hole is intended to be fun and cathartic.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Today, I want to share another project: a black hole website where you can throw in your thoughts.
So far, it has swallowed 1,205 thoughts. I think it’s fun. Sometimes, when I feel upset, I write something down and drop it into the black hole. Afterwards, I feel a little lighter.
Maybe you can try it too:
https://blackhole.echoscarrie.com/
